module_title: Iconic Landmarks and World Heritage Sites
introduction: This level covers the 'Evergreen' monuments of India. These are the most frequently asked questions in SSC and Railway exams regarding their builders and locations.

core_concepts.title: Konark Sun Temple
core_concepts.description:
Location: **Odisha**. 
Builder: **Narasimhadeva I** (Eastern Ganga Dynasty - 13th Century). 
Key Feature: Known as the **'Black Pagoda'**. It is designed as a colossal chariot with 24 wheels. 
Currency: Featured on the back of the **₹10 note**.

core_concepts.title: Khajuraho Group of Temples
core_concepts.description:
Location: Chhatarpur, **Madhya Pradesh**. 
Builder: **Chandela Dynasty**. 
Key Feature: Famous for Nagara-style architecture and erotic sculptures. The most prominent temple here is the **Kandariya Mahadeva Temple**.

core_concepts.title: Sanchi Stupa
core_concepts.description:
Location: Sanchi, **Madhya Pradesh**. 
Builder: Emperor **Ashoka** (Maurya Dynasty). 
Key Feature: One of the oldest stone structures in India, built to house the relics of Lord Buddha. 
Currency: Featured on the **₹200 note**.

core_concepts.title: Taj Mahal
core_concepts.description:
Location: Agra, Uttar Pradesh. 
Builder: Mughal Emperor **Shah Jahan** (in memory of Mumtaz Mahal). 
Architect: **Ustad Ahmad Lahauri**.

important_entities.name: White Pagoda
important_entities.significance: While Konark is the 'Black Pagoda' (due to its dark color viewed from the sea), the Jagannath Temple in Puri is called the 'White Pagoda' by sailors.

trap_alerts_and_exceptions.explanation: Exam Trap: Students often confuse Khajuraho with the Gupta or Mughal period. Remember, Khajuraho is strictly the contribution of the **Chandela** kings.

mnemonics_and_tricks.explanation: Khajuraho (Khajur tree) was built by the Chandela (Chanda/Moon) Dynasty.

exam_strategy_tips: A patent SSC question: 'Which king built the Konark Sun Temple?' Answer: Narasimhadeva I of the Eastern Ganga Dynasty.
